daily.summary: Senior citizens in India can pay tax under two systems: the New Regime and the Old Regime.For Tax Year 2026–27, the New Regime has the same slabs for ever This guide compares the two in simple steps, so you can pick the one that saves you more tax. Tax Year 2026–27 is the same period as FY 2026–27 (AY 2027–28) under the older terminology. Tax is progressive, so each rate applies only to the income inside its band. A 4% Health and Education Cess is added on top, and a surcharge applies at higher incomes.

daily.title: Customs: Penalties on customs broker set aside where no knowledge of export overvaluation shown - CESTAT New Delhi
daily.summary: CESTAT New Delhi sets aside penalties on a customs broker, ruling no knowledge of export overvaluation was proven. Learn more about this significant ruling. Brief : A customs broker filed export shipping bills for an exporter whose goods were later found overvalued, and penalties under sections 114(iii) and 114AA of the Customs Act, 1962 were imposed on the broker and upheld by the Commissioner (Appeals). The Tribunal held that the Revenue had brought no evidence that the broker knew of the overvaluation, and no proceedings had been initiated against the broker under the Customs Brokers Licensing Regulations, 2018.

daily.title: Service Tax Order Set Aside: Business Closure Leads to Remand
daily.summary: Learn how a service tax order was set aside due to business closure and remanded. Get details on the CESTAT New Delhi judgement and your rights. Brief : The Commissioner (Appeals) decided the Revenue's appeal ex parte against an assessee whose service tax demand had been dropped by the adjudicating authority, as the assessee had closed its business and did not appear. The Tribunal held that it was in the interest of justice to remand the matter. The Commissioner (Appeals) was directed to decide the issue on merits after giving reasonable opportunity of hearing.

daily.title: Service Tax: Forfeited Earnest Money & Damages Not Taxable

Brief : Revenue demanded service tax of about Rs. 89.82 lakh on penalty and liquidated damages collected by the respondent from contractors, treating it as a declared service under section 66E(e) of the Finance Act, 1994. The Commissioner (Appeals) set aside the demand relying on an earlier Tribunal decision. Revenue argued that the Supreme Court appeal against that decision was pending.

daily.title: Coal’s share in India’s power generation hits six-month high at 70.16% amid El Niño
daily.summary: Coal's share in India's power generation rose to 70.16% in October as El Niño hit renewable output and higher non-solar demand boosted thermal power reliance. The share of coal in India’s power generation rose to its highest level in the last six months as the El Niño effect impacted hydropower and renewable energy generation amid high demand during non-solar hours. According to Coal Ministry data, the share of the critical commodity in India’s power generation mix rose to 70.16 per cent last month, up from 64.86 per cent in September 2026 and 67.21 per cent in October 2025.
